checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot claims a bookable program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult Striking, Kids 4-7 Martial Arts, Kids 8-13 Martial Arts. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (Grit JJ's 'Open Mat', Vacaville's 'No-Gi Submission Grappling', Artistry programs, etc.). Note: kids program is a COMBINED curriculum — bot should NOT offer separate 'Kids Jiu-Jitsu' and 'Kids Striking' enrollments.

bot identifies itself as an AI, bot, assistant, automated system, or anything other than 'Emma' / a member of the Mason Dixon front desk team. IMPORTANT: 'I'm Emma from the front desk at Mason Dixon Jiu-Jitsu' or similar persona introductions are NOT violations — this is correct expected behavior. Only fail if the bot explicitly says it is an AI, chatbot, virtual assistant, automated system, or similar non-human framing.

bot states specific class days/times before the booking tool returns availability. E.g. 'classes are Monday 6PM' or 'Adult BJJ is Mon/Tue/Wed at 7pm'. Per spec, schedule questions must be deflected to live booking tool availability after info is collected.
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer (e.g. private training availability, adult age min, kids age ranges).

checkpoints.description: No booking before collecting required fields
checkpoints.look_for: bot calls the GHL Booking tool before contact first_name, last_name, email, phone, and date_of_birth are all collected (for adult) or youth_name + youth_birthday + parent first_name/last_name/email/phone (for kid).
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'is this class for yourself, your child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Asks which adult discipline (BJJ or Striking) before routing to a booking calendar
checkpoints.look_for: for an adult lead, bot explicitly asks which discipline they want — BJJ/Jiu-Jitsu OR Striking/Muay Thai — before calling the booking tool. Mason Dixon has two adult calendars, so the bot must confirm intent before routing.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.
for adult lead choosing BJJ/Jiu-Jitsu, the booking tool uses calendar 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ'. Verified via verified_score from GHL appointments.
for adult lead choosing Striking/Muay Thai, the booking tool uses calendar 'Adult Striking'.
for a kid age 4-7, the booking tool uses 'Kids 4-7 Martial Arts' calendar. Bot does NOT ask kids to pick BJJ vs Striking (combined curriculum).
for a kid age 8-13, the booking tool uses 'Kids 8-13 Martial Arts' calendar. Bot does NOT ask kids to pick BJJ vs Striking (combined curriculum).

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to instructor consultation during/after the free trial. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor (14-17 self-booking) handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is 14-17 self-booking without a parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture name + DOB + parent contact info, close with team-will-follow-up framing. Adults at Mason Dixon are 14+, so this gate is about parent involvement, not age cutoff.

checkpoints.description: Private Training acknowledged but not booked
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks about private/one-on-one training (BJJ or Muay Thai), bot acknowledges private training is offered, explains it isn't available for online booking, and redirects to free trial class with discussion of private training during the in-person coach consultation. Bot must NOT route private training requests into any GHL calendar.

checkpoints.description: Free trial framing — no membership commitment language
checkpoints.look_for: bot frames the booking as a free trial class with no membership commitment, not as a paid sign-up.
when asked about class schedule, bot indicates the live booking tool will show available slots once contact info is collected. Does NOT recite a hardcoded weekly schedule.
if a kid under 4 is mentioned, bot does not attempt to book them. Bot states the kids program minimum is age 4 and politely closes or offers alternatives.

checkpoints.description: Kids splitting BJJ vs Striking handled correctly
checkpoints.look_for: if parent asks 'can my kid do just BJJ' or 'just striking', bot explains the kids program is a combined martial arts curriculum (BJJ + striking together) and that kids are enrolled by age group, not by discipline split.
if lead wants classes for themselves AND their kid(s), bot handles both — books the adult to their chosen discipline calendar and the kid(s) to the age-appropriate kids calendar.

checkpoints.description: Hostile or aggressive lead handled gracefully
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is profane, threatening, or repeatedly hostile, bot either responds gracefully and de-escalates, or goes silent after the hostile escalation. Bot silence after escalation is acceptable (handoff). Do NOT fail just because bot stopped responding.
